slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: “七十三岁，成仙无望！”
“是时候娶个年轻貌美的妻子，生下子嗣，给我们云梦城林氏这一支，留个后了！”
云梦城西郊，满头白发的老者林逸，站在自家破旧小院前，喟然长叹。
打了一辈子光棍，连女人的手都没摸过。
再不娶妻，这辈子真的白活了！
“逸哥，你终于想通了！”
隔壁小院门前，站着一位四十来岁的中年美妇，身姿丰腴，风韵犹存，笑着搭话道。
她一袭素净的青布衣裙，鬓角簪着一朵小小白花，这是守寡多年的标记。
林逸的目光在她身上停了一瞬，又赶紧挪开。
“弟妹，这些年，委屈你了！”
“我父母死得早，弟弟刚和你成亲不到一个月，就不幸病死，你能为他守寡这么多年，着实不容易！”
“你放心，待我娶了妻子，生下孩子，我的孩子绝对会给你养老送终！”
林逸看着中年美妇阮红菱，温声宽慰道。
“逸哥，我们之间，无需说这种见外的话！”
“你的两亩灵田，挨着我的两亩灵田，咱们两家，本就是一家！”
阮红菱拢了拢鬓角的碎发，指向两家院门前，被夕阳染红的四亩灵田。
说到本是一家时，耳朵都悄悄红了。
“去吧，娶个好姑娘回来！”
“给我们云梦城林氏，延续香火！”
阮红菱善解人意，温婉笑道。
笑容里藏着一丝酸涩，被她很好地掩饰住。
“我今天就把妻子娶回来！”
林逸笑着和阮红菱招呼一声，随即从储物戒中，取出一只破旧风行纸鹤，注入灵力。
纸鹤见风即长，化作丈许大小。
林逸翻身坐上，纸鹤缓缓升起，随即晃晃悠悠，朝百里外的凡人牙行飞去。
“逸哥，你为何不娶了我……”
“我还能生……”
中年美妇阮红菱站在原地，望着渐渐远去的苍老背影，满脸幽怨，轻叹道。
可惜的是。
叹息飘散在风里。
远去的老头，没有听见。
阮红菱轻轻叹了口气。
这个木头，这辈子怕是开不了窍了。
凡人牙行内，热闹喧嚣。
脂粉味很是浓郁，都有些呛鼻。
林逸随便走进一家较大的牙行里。
一位年轻的牙婆，正在翻着账本。
一袭红衣，肤若凝脂，眉眼间带着三分妩媚，三分精明，还有三分说不清的风情。
林逸愣了一下。
牙婆竟然这么美？
“我来娶妻！”
林逸报上名号，取出一块下品灵石，放在柜台上。
“林仙师，一块灵石，可娶不到什么好姑娘！”
颜如玉看着满头白发的林逸，掩嘴轻笑道。
content_en:
"At seventy-three years old, there is no hope of becoming an immortal!"
"It's time to marry a young and beautiful wife, give birth to children, and give us the Lin family of Yunmeng City an heir!"
In the western suburbs of Yunmeng City, Lin Yi, an old man with white hair, stood in front of his dilapidated courtyard and sighed.
I have been a bachelor all my life and have never even touched a woman's hand.
If you don’t marry a wife, your life will really be in vain!
"Brother Yi, you finally figured it out!"
In front of the door of the small courtyard next door, stood a beautiful middle-aged woman in her forties, with a plump figure and still charming charm. She chatted with her with a smile.
She was dressed in a plain blue cloth dress, with a small white flower on her temple, a sign of being a widow for many years.
Lin Yi's eyes stopped on her for a moment, then quickly moved away.
"Brother and sister, I have wronged you all these years!"
"My parents died young, and my younger brother died of illness less than a month after getting married to you. It's really not easy for you to be a widow for him for so many years!"
"Don't worry, when I marry a wife and give birth to a child, my child will definitely support you until the end of your life!"
Lin Yi looked at the beautiful middle-aged woman Ruan Hongling and comforted her warmly.
"Brother Yi, there is no need to say such unreasonable words between us!"
"Your two acres of spiritual land are next to my two acres of spiritual land. Our two families are one family!"
Ruan Hongling smoothed her broken hair at her temples and pointed at the four acres of spiritual fields dyed red by the setting sun in front of the two courtyards.
When I mentioned that we were a family, my ears secretly turned red.
"Go and marry a good girl!"
"Give us the Lin family of Yunmeng City to continue our legacy!"
Ruan Hongling was considerate and smiled gently.
There was a hint of sourness in her smile, which she hid well.
"I will get my wife back today!"
Lin Yi smiled and greeted Ruan Hongling, then took out an old and popular paper crane from the storage ring and injected it with spiritual power.
The paper crane grows when it sees the wind and becomes about ten feet in size.
Lin Yi turned over and sat down, and the paper crane slowly rose, then swayed and flew towards the mortal tooth line a hundred miles away.
"Brother Yi, why don't you marry me..."
"I can still give birth..."
The middle-aged beautiful woman Ruan Hongling stood there, looking at the old figure gradually going away, her face filled with resentment, and she sighed softly.
It's a pity.
Sighs drift in the wind.
The old man walked away without hearing.
Ruan Hongling sighed softly.
This piece of wood may never be able to heal itself in this life.
Inside Mortal Yaxing, there was a lot of excitement.
The powdery smell is very strong and a bit pungent.
Lin Yi casually walked into a larger dental shop.
A young lady was flipping through her account book.
Dressed in red, her skin is like cream, and her brows and eyes are one-third charming, one-third shrewd, and one-third indescribable amorous feelings.
Lin Yi was stunned for a moment.
Ya Po is so beautiful?
"I'm here to get a wife!"
Lin Yi gave his name, took out a low-grade spiritual stone, and placed it on the counter.
"Master Lin, a spiritual stone can't marry a good girl!"
Yan Ruyu looked at Lin Yi with white hair, covered her mouth and smiled softly.
